indicator_definition: Proportion of the coastline experiencing erosion as a percentage of total assessed coastline. Compiled by the EEA using satellite monitoring and the EUROSION database.
rationale: Coastal erosion is accelerating due to sea level rise and human pressures. Progress means limiting the proportion of coastline experiencing erosion.
methodology_characteristics: Data compiled by the EEA using Copernicus Land Monitoring and historical shoreline position comparisons. Published periodically.
